description: Calculate how much revenue a business loses to missed phone calls per month and per year, and which price tier of answering service makes sense at that loss level. Use when someone mentions missing calls, going to voicemail, losing leads after hours, or asks whether an answering service is worth it for their call volume. Inputs: calls per week, percent missed, average customer value, optional booking rate.

avgCustomerValue.description: Average value of one new customer in USD (1-100000)

bookRatePercent.description: Percent of missed callers who would have booked; default 30

name: missed_call_roi
title: Missed-call revenue loss calculator
